summary: Implemented bounded include/exclude glob evaluation and repository/global ignore precedence on top of the W04-S01 traversal frontier. The Search source now applies compiled path policy before yielding files, lazily loads ancestor ignore sources, preserves rule provenance, prunes only permitted directories, honors negation and explicit file-root override, and retains typed access failures.

review.reviewer: separate grill-code review pass (no independent subagent was available)

startingState.worktree: Tracked files were clean at scope start; the local ignored campaign state was already recording W04-S02 as in_progress. W04-S02 implementation, tests and evidence were added afterward.
startingState.aheadNote: The ahead count includes the retained pre-existing docs/campaigns ignore commit; 21 preceding reachable commits carry completed Search scope trailers.

implementation.scopeBoundary: Only the owning Search implementation and its tests were changed, together with W04-S02 evidence. No public SQL/source signature, sibling repository, query-engine adapter, release or publish surface was modified.

policy.includeExclude: Include and exclude globs are compiled once per scope enumeration. Basename globs match the candidate name at any depth, while slash-qualified and anchored globs match normalized relative paths.
policy.directoryPruning: Only an explicit directory-only exclude or an ignored directory prunes a subtree; a file-extension include cannot prune an unmatched directory.
policy.globalSource: Configured global rules are an internal frozen seam, precedence 0, disabled unless GlobalIgnorePolicy.Configured is selected.
policy.ruleEvaluation: Rules are loaded lazily from ancestors to descendants. Higher source precedence, then deeper directory scope, then later rule order selects the matching decision. Ignored parents are pruned before descendant ignore files can reopen them.
policy.provenance: Each compiled ignore rule retains source path, precedence, directory depth, line number, order and negation state for later explanation/fingerprint work.
policy.rootFile: An explicit file root is yielded directly and bypasses directory-scoped ignore and pruning rules.

implementation.traversalIntegration: SearchScopeTraversal supplies a policy callback to the W04-S01 explicit stack, so denied directories are skipped before their enumerators are opened and all existing frontier cancellation/disposal behavior remains active.

requiredCoverage: include/exclude filtering without unsafe directory pruning

knownLimitations: Hidden-entry, symbolic-link/reparse-point, special-file and explicit inaccessible-entry policies remain later implementation scopes; this scope does not silently claim those flags are complete.

The public request binder does not yet expose the internal configured global-rule collection, and this scope does not add machine-global ignore-file lookup. The binding/configuration and scope fingerprint belong to later contract scopes.
The full candidate decision manifest and loaded ignore-source content hashes are not yet emitted as an audit result; only rule provenance is retained internally in this scope.
Filesystem enumeration is live rather than snapshot-atomic, and SQL result order still requires an explicit ORDER BY.
